---
title: "Demographic Only KNN"
---

```{r}
data = read.csv("datasets\\train\\train_demographic.csv")
test_data = read.csv("datasets\\test\\test_demographic.csv")
head(data)
data$main.disorder <- as.factor(data$main.disorder)
test_data$main.disorder <- factor(test_data$main.disorder, levels = levels(data$main.disorder))

for (column in c("age", "education", "IQ")) {
  training_median <- median(data[[column]], na.rm = TRUE)
  data[[column]][is.na(data[[column]])] <- training_median
  test_data[[column]][is.na(test_data[[column]])] <- training_median
}
```
```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(yardstick)
# install.packages("kknn")

knn_spec <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors = 5) |>
  set_engine("kknn") |>
  set_mode("classification")

knn_fit <- knn_spec |>
    fit( main.disorder ~ sex+age+education+IQ, data = data)

knn_fit$fit
```

```{r}

test_results <- knn_fit |>
  augment(new_data = test_data)

test_results |>
  conf_mat(truth = main.disorder, estimate = .pred_class)

test_results |>
  metrics(truth = main.disorder, estimate = .pred_class)

class_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, sens, spec)

test_results |>
  class_metrics(truth = main.disorder, estimate = .pred_class)

writeLines(capture.output({ print(test_results |> conf_mat(truth = main.disorder, estimate = .pred_class)); print(test_results |> metrics(truth = main.disorder, estimate = .pred_class)) }), "KNN_demographic_only_results.txt")

```
